key_insight: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary program search using agent swarms that reason and exchange ideas in latent space rather than through lengthy text.
engineering_relevance: Latent-space collaboration could reduce search time and inference costs when optimizing programs for scientific computing and mathematical discovery.
method: Run hundreds of low-cost agents per round in swarms exploring different approaches.
Select distinct ideas using distances between agents’ hidden-state vectors.
Combine swarm members’ KV caches in a summarizer agent to enable latent-space crossover.
evidence_signal: Across 21 problems, SwarmEvolve achieved the highest average score and matched scores reached by competing frameworks at 60 minutes in a median of 3–8 minutes.
watch_item: KV-cache sharing requires access to model internals, which may limit deployment through standard hosted LLM APIs.
paper_title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
